C1.stable_choice_operationalization: At least one pair of levels has >=2 families with left Joint 2/2 and right 0/2, and >=2 other families with the reverse. Tied successes do not establish opposite preference.
C1.clarification_timing: Before any real C02 outcome; conservative operationalization of the existing stable-better/no-dominance condition, not a change based on model scores.

cost_labels.complete_meaning: All known model input usage attributable to this cell, including repair selection and binding; unknown usage makes complete=false. Shared first analysis/selection is reported separately as common overhead.
cost_labels.preferred_level: Among levels with Joint 2/2, minimum actual mean complete cell input tokens, ties lower level. Missing any acceptable level cost leaves preferred_level=null.
